FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
What services are offered at the Raleigh, NC, Raleigh dental office?

We provide all the necessary dental services such as routine cleanings and exams, fillings, pediatric dental procedures, gum contouring, fluoride treatment, and so much more!

How do I schedule an appointment in Raleigh, NC?

To schedule a visit, feel free to call us or book an appointment online to get you in as soon as possible! We look forward to treating you and providing you with the comfort and care you deserve!

Does the Raleigh location provide orthodontic treatment like Invisalign®?

Yes! We have an amazing team of professionals ready to help you with your Invisalign needs to discreetly straighten your teeth for a brighter, natural smile.

Can I get same-day emergency dental treatment in Raleigh, NC?

Yes. At our office, we recognize that emergencies happen and offer care in times of need. We will do our very best to get you in as soon as possible, ideally the same or next day if you contact us outside of operating hours. If we can’t see you at our Six Forks location, we will redirect you to our other nearby offices that may be able to accommodate short notice, after-hours, or weekend visits for emergencies. We won’t leave you in pain and will do what it takes to care for you!

What cosmetic dental services are offered in Raleigh?

We understand the impact a confident smile has on our patients' lives, and therefore, we offer cosmetic services that include whitening, veneers, and Invisalign®.

Is wisdom teeth removal available at the Raleigh office?

Yes. Our expert team can remove your wisdom teeth before or after they come in. We prioritize your comfort throughout the process and make sure the removal process is painless and relaxing.

Where is the Raleigh, NC, office located, and when is it open?

Our office Hours are Monday-Thursday: 8:00 AM – 4:00 PM, Friday: 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM. We are closed on Saturday and Sunday. Our Raleigh office is located at 3614 Haworth Dr, Raleigh, NC 27609. We look forward to seeing you!

Do you accept insurance or offer membership plans in Raleigh, NC?

We accept and participate with a large majority of insurance plans. Before any treatment, our team will perform a complimentary benefits evaluation to let you know what your insurance covers. We also offer flexible payment options and an affordable dental membership plan for patients without insurance.

What technology or comfort options are available for patient care?

We use Digital X-rays, which have small sensors and X-ray film tabs, and can provide two types of images: intraoral, for inside the mouth, and extraoral, for outside the mouth. Bitewing X-rays are the most commonly used intraoral X-rays; for extraoral X-rays, the panoramic X-ray is the most common. 

What sedation options are available for anxious patients in Raleigh, NC?

We offer a variety of sedation dentistry options. You can choose from Nitrous Oxide, IV Sedation, and Local Anesthesia.
